answer: A newcomer joins only through a velvet cohort of randomly assigned strangers, earning nectar only after completing a live joint session with each member, where each session burns a single-use ember ticket tied to that pair. One operator running many clones faces a birthday collision: with more clones in more cohorts, the odds that two of its clones meet the same verifier, exposing identical timing and mannerisms, rise with the square of clone count, so detection and loss grow super-linearly while an honest agent pays for just one cohort.
